item.title: Twake Drive – An open-source alternative to Google Drive
item.description:
📝 Twake Drive The open-source alternative to Google Drive. com/linagora/twake-drive Run it with Docker cd tdrive docker compose -f docker-compose. x) MongoDB Yarn (recommended) Setup Launch MongoDB using docker run -p 27017:27017 -d mongo Launch frontend with cd tdrive/frontend/; yarn dev:start Launch backend with cd tdrive/backend/node/; SEARCH_DRIVER=mongodb DB_DRIVER=mongodb PUBSUB_TYPE=local \ DB_MONGO_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017 STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH=/[full-path-to-store-documents]/documents \ NODE_ENV=development yarn dev If you need more parameters, create/edit tdrive/backend/node/config/development.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive

item.title: Mesh2Motion – Open-source web application to animate 3D models
item.description:
📝 Bring Your 3D Models to Life Mesh2Motion is a FREE & open-source web application to animate your 3D models. Try it out 🥳 Human & Animal rigs Supports importing GLB, GLTF, and FBX models Human and animal skeleton options Intuitive skeleton positioning Undo/Redo system when you make mistakes ✔️ Export Animations Export multiple animations at once Uses widely-supported GLB format Human animation library from Quaternius Video Walkthrough FREE & Open-Source Mesh2Motion is an open-source project. com/scottpetrovic/mesh2motion-app @scottpetrovic @scottpetrovic.
🔗 Read more: https://mesh2motion.org/
